_comment: Vertical 9:16 variant of red-card. Presets scale by the HEIGHT ratio, so landscape->vertical enlarges text x1.78 while the frame gets NARROWER; 7-word groups wrap into tall cards. max_words 6 + min_active_ms 40 is a VERIFIED PAIR -- both spans of this video's five episodes clear the builder's self-check with it, and changing either alone breaks a clip. If a new video trips 'group N overlaps group N-1', a group's min-active cascade ran past the next group's start; nudge max_words/min_active together and re-test every clip. Do not edit the builder to silence the check.

overlays._note: Colour of the SOURCE video's own lower-third graphics to dodge (not your card colour). Targeted mode is reliable; auto is experimental and false-positives on saturated props.
